### Style of a delivered page

`DeliveredStyle` · `src/delivery.ts:19` · status: **held**

The variables the style sheets use, written in the root rule from the values of the decisions they name (each a record of names and values), then the sheets themselves, in the order the delivery names them.

Section: Delivered page

| Mark | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `root` | `:root` | The root element: its variables hold for the whole page |

| Input | Writes | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| `[{"space-sm":"8px","leading":1.5}], ["body { margin: var(--space-sm); }"]` | `":root { --space-sm: 8px; --leading: 1.5; }\nbody { margin: var(--space-sm); }"` | held, read as CSS style sheets |
| `[], ["body { margin: 0; }"]` | `"body { margin: 0; }"` | held, read as CSS style sheets |
